test_title: PYST 3: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The editor will revise the entire draft before it is printed.

options.text: The entire draft is revised by the editor.
The entire draft will be revised by the editor before it is printed.
The entire draft shall be revised before printing.
The editor has revised the entire draft.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The editor will revise the entire draft before it is printed." 
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the entire draft" at the beginning. 
 
• Change the active verb form "will revise" to "will be revised&
